User.Response: "two of my friends relapsed, they called to see if they get kicked out of their three-quarter house if they could come stay with me I said yes and then had to send a text message saying no after speaking with a girl that I met at an AA meeting last night. after seeing my parents for less than an hour tonight I felt like they don’t understand what recovery is and only care about how much money I’m making and if I’m working for them. I also cleaned my grandmothers house I’m trying to help her get out of the depression that she’s been in she is also not feeling well I had to make her go to the hospital. I feel like the language and tone my mother used around me during that time was just rude. she doesnt think before she speaks nor does she realize how she triggers me. she also makes it impossible for me to talk to her about my honest feelings. we lack the ability to communicate with each other without one of us being upset. The good part of my day was explaining some of my goals to my therapist as well as an advocate at sages army. sometimes I think that I’m not going to be able to live in such close proximity to my patents and that hurts me because i love them, and my nephews are close- but it may be better for me to recover somewhere else. I have no desire to go back to working for them without adjustments and I don’t have the willpower to not get depressed there if i do work there - i’m afraid it’s going to trigger me to drink or use. so im going to get on an online meeting, cause I don’t know what else to do at this point. 🤙🏾"

User.Response: "I have felt incredibly stressed and anxious all day. i had new chest pains and had to skip a volunteer activity because of it. That stressed me out more but i knew i needed to rest and to try to relax. I am attending the funeral of a friend i met in rehab. My roommate from rehab called me and told me she has to get a double mastectomy. after that conversation my anxiety sky rocketed and i have felt like shit ever since. dealing with anxiety without marijuana is very hard. A friend from home stayed with me today and without that i would of pushed myseld over the edge with activities and i would of mentally and physically crashed by now. I am glad i can recognize that. tomorrow is going to be stressful. i want to be there for my friends at the funeral and i want it to remind me that drugs and being numb will never save me. i did go thrifting with my friend and he got me a sick typewriter that i am so excited about. i want to give myself time away from my phone and social media and start writing again. it will help me mentally and in my recovery "

User.Response: good: went to family support group at recovery capital and got to understand how I hert ppl with my addiction and learn. support at recovery capital and peers I have ment there was right there for me bc I am going through home life challenges. I got to attend GED classes witch recovery capital introduced to me. I always feel like I'm part of a loving family there and I don't always get that in my home life so that's nice.. my day was challenging like it is so often and I try to look at the positive side and having a community that I know is right there with me helps so much.I was fr about to go to sheetz and get some 4 locos but froze and thought about all the good stuff I have going on for me bc of the recovery capital. I'm feeling overwhelmed and so on edge but also greatful and strong. I also have gotten involved with the community like I have always wanted to do but I never knew how. some staff and members have picked up on the fact that if something isn't told to me that's going on and a flyer shown to me then I have no idea what's going on. the recovery capital is like this plug in to the rest of the world that I have been waiting for. I'm not so lost anymore. I feel like I belong to something so important. I hope to grow and learn and I will make a difference one day. that's the hope I have found.my life was much different before the recovery capital. I would lay around depressed, not leave my room some days on end. I wouldn't go to appts. I wasn't doing anything with my life. I didn't understand boundaries or self respect. and I have worked on some of that stuff myself but I have had smart ppl around me to ask about some of my thoughts and understandings. recovery capital like lit up my road to recovery and not just with drugs and alcohol but mental health and from my toxic past also.. I'm being so truthful it's just beyond what I thought I could ever find in a place.. I'm changing and growing daily. today was hard so I sit and remind myself these things,

User.Response: today in group I let everyone know, I relapsed late saterday, early Sunday. I got black out drunk. my brother is in jail and I got a letter from him about a week ago. we are very close but he is very bad for me and my family. I'm very worried about when he gets out. sense I got that letter I have been in self destruction mode and didn't realize it. my crs from recovery capital realized it and we talked about it. now that I see whats happening I'll work to change it and watch for the signs next time. I'm writing my brother a letter to tell him about how my boundaries with him have to be when he gets out. when I told everyone in our meeting today what I had done, I didn't get one judgemental look, no one said anything to me then or after, everyone excepted me. I didn't get the same treatment at home. being truthful in my recovery is important and I'm greatful I can go to the recovery capital and not only be cared about but be excepted for me and my challenges.. what I get from recovery capital is something I have longed for in my family and in my life and I have never got it anywhere else. it's a true pure loving connection. I get so much out of going there that in 3 months I have got 3 other ppl to join. I hope that one day this is a resource that everyone has available. I'm going to work as hard as I can to be a positive face of recovery. I know I still have a way to go but I keep learning and growing and although I relapsed, I learn from my screw ups. and alot of the learning I do while at the recovery capital, to me that's litterly the hole point of the place. so many tools there.

User.Response: I had to go to the court house twice today. I went to recovery capital and got bangs, they make me feel pretty and younger. and it's free. I talked to a staff about me starting to use work out equipment there and I'm excited to do that.. my father inlaw asked me to pick up his prescription and I said yes right away not thinking about it. when I picked his script up it was pain pills. I had alot of bad thoughts but I pushed them all away keeping in mind all the progress I'm making in my life and also how much better I feel about fighting the temptation tords wanting to do them. I took someone shopping to be helpful. I make some appts that needed made.. I went to arc manor for intake so I can get into a class they have for girls who have went through domestic violence.. I don't only think I can get stuff out of the class but I also think an open person like me could be very helpful to other girls in the class.. today has me feeling very optimistic about my future.. I'm on this path alone in alot of ways but the recover capital remains me that I'm not conpleatly alone, there is for real other ppl on the same path as me, at the same time, in the same town! the support of corse is more proof I don't have to do it all alone..I wrote my brother a long letter about boundaries.. I'll send it soon.. nervous about him getting out of jail and causing me more problems with his addiction so I'm setting my boundaries very clearly and the consequences of crossing them..starting to like this daily thing, it's like a minni Journal except it really does mean something and can help make a difference so thanks for that.. xoxo
